author: jaaaydeeeezy
quote: I wanted to give it a fair chance, the first 2 missions where you're flying the plane and saving the Cal were pretty fun. The driving is too hard and too much traffic and then you have to like deposit your money or you lose it, or you have a mission you need to buy a gun but you need to drive back to your house and get your money, then all the dumb painting the wall to make a fat gf happy. Played it for like 4 hours to give it a shot and it's just whack. What happened to buying hookers and running over everyone and seeing how long you can last from cops, this game is bad
